chapterInfo.content:
13
Ɔman no seanteɛ
1Sɛ AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me nie: Kɔ na kɔtɔ nwera abɔsoɔ na fa bɔ w’asene, na mfa mmɔ nsuo mu. 2Ɛnna medii AWURADE asɛm no soɔ, kɔtɔɔ abɔsoɔ no, na mede mebɔɔ m’asene. 3Na AWURADE asɛm baa me nkyɛn, ne mprenu soɔ sɛ: 4Fa abɔsoɔ a wotɔeɛ a ɛbɔ w’asene no, na sɔre kɔ Eufrate, na fa kɔhyɛ ɔbotan tokuro mu. 5Na mesii mu mede mekɔhintaa Eufrate, sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ me no. 6Na nna pii akyiri no, AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Sɔre kɔ Eufrate, na kɔfa abɔsoɔ a mehyɛɛ wo sɛ fa kɔsie hɔ no bra. 7Na mesii mu mekɔɔ Eufrate, na mekɔbɔre mefaa abɔsoɔ no firii deɛ mede mekɔsieɛ no; na hwɛ, na abɔsoɔ no asu, ɛnyɛ mma hwee.
8Ɛnna AWURADE asɛm baa me nkyɛn sɛ: 9Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Saa ara na mɛsɛe Yuda ahantan ne Yerusalem ahantan bebrebe no. 10#Yer 11.8 Ɔmammɔne yi a wɔmpɛ sɛ wɔtie me nsɛm, na wɔnam wɔn akoma denyɛ mu, na wɔdi anyame foforɔ akyiri som wɔn sɔre wɔn no, wɔbɛyɛ sɛ saa abɔsoɔ a ɛnyɛ mma hwee yi. 11Na sɛdeɛ abɔsoɔ fam onipa asene no, saa ara na mama Israel fie nyinaa ne Yuda fie nyinaa afam me ho, AWURADE asɛm nie, sɛ wɔnyɛ me ɔman, ne din ne ayeyie, ne animuonyam, nanso wɔantie.
12Enti ka asɛm yi kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn seɛ nie: Nsa bɛyɛ mpɔre nyinaa ma ma. Na wɔbɛka akyerɛ wo sɛ: Nim na yɛnnim sɛ nsa bɛyɛ mpɔre nyinaa amaama anaa? 13#Yer 25.15-18; Yes 51.17 Na ka kyerɛ wɔn sɛ: Sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Hwɛ, mɛma asase yi sofoɔ nyinaa, ne ahemfo a wɔtete Dawid adwa soɔ, ne asɔfoɔ ne adiyifoɔ, ne Yerusalemfoɔ nyinaa aboboro titaa. 14Na mede wɔn bɛbobɔ wɔn ho wɔn ho, agyanom ne mma nyinaa, AWURADE asɛm nie. Merenhu wɔn mmɔbɔ, na merennya tema mma wɔn, na me yam renhyehye me, sɛ merensɛe wɔn.
Kɔkɔbɔ, abooboodie ne duema
15Montie, na monyɛ aso; monnyɛ ahantan,
na AWURADE na akasa.
16Monhyɛ AWURADE mo Nyankopɔn animuonyam
ansa na wama sum aduru,
ansa na mo nan asunti
mmepɔ kusuu no,
na morehwɛ hann kwan a,
wadane no sunsum,
na wama sum kabii aduru.
17 # Yer 9.1 Na sɛ moantie a,
me kra bɛsu kokoam, mo ahantan nti,
na m’ani afiri nisuo ara,
na nisuo aporepore me,
sɛ wɔafa AWURADE nnwankuo no nnommum mu.
18 # Kwa 5.16 Se ɔhene ne ɔhemmaa no sɛ:
Mommrɛ mo ho ase ntena ase,
na mo animuonyam abotire
afiri mo atifi atɔ.
19Wɔatoto Negeb nkuro no mu,
na obiara nni hɔ a ɔbɛhini;
wɔatu Yuda nyinaa kɔ nnommum mu,
wɔatu wɔn kɔ korakora.
20Ma w’ani so na hwɛ
wɔn a wɔfiri atifi fam reba yi,
ɛhe na wo mmoakuo a wɔde maa woɔ,
w’animuonyam nnwankuo no wɔ?
21Sɛ ɔde wɔn a wo ara woayɛne wɔn
sɛ wo nnamfonom si wo so atitire a,
ɛdeɛn na wobɛka?
Awoɔ renka wo
sɛ ɔbaa wofoɔ anaa?
22 # Yes 47.2-3; Hes 16.37 Na sɛ wose no w’akoma mu sɛ:
Ɛdeɛn nti na yeinom ato me yi a,
w’amumuyɛ bebree nti
na wɔayi w’atadeɛ nhyɛaseɛ adie,
wɔahyɛ wo nantin yea.
23 # Dwom 55.19 Etiopiani bɛtumi asakyera ne wedeɛ,
anaasɛ ɔsebɔ bɛsakyera ne ho nworonnworan?
Ɛnneɛ mo nso mobɛtumi ayɛ papa,
mo a bɔneyɛ akokwa mo.
24Enti mɛbɔ wɔn apete sɛ ntɛtɛ
a anwea pradada so mframa de no rekorɔ.
25Yei ne w’adeɛ a wobɛnya,
wo kyɛfa a masusu mama woɔ, AWURADE asɛm nie,
ɛfiri sɛ wo werɛ afiri me,
na wode wo ho ato atorɔ so.
26 # Yer 13.22 Na me nso mɛyi w’atadeɛ nhyɛaseɛ mabua w’anim,
na wɔahunu w’ahohora no.
27W’akyiwadeɛ a ɛne w’awaresɛeɛ, ne wo hwenemporeɛ,
w’adwamammɔ atantanneɛ,
wiram nkokoɔ so, na mahunu.
Due, O Yerusalem!
Ɛnkɔsi da bɛn na wo ho bɛte bio?

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
